tables.name: deduplication_log
tables.create_table_query: CREATE TABLE etl.deduplication_log (`_dedup_key` String, `_batch_id` String, `_stage` String, `_processed_at` DateTime64(3), `_row_id` UUID) ENGINE = ReplacingMergeTree(_processed_at) PARTITION BY toYYYYMM(_processed_at) ORDER BY (_dedup_key, _stage) SETTINGS index_granularity = 8192

tables.name: quality_anomalies
tables.create_table_query: CREATE TABLE etl.quality_anomalies (`_anomaly_id` UUID DEFAULT generateUUIDv4(), `_batch_id` String, `_source_id` String, `_detected_at` DateTime64(3), `_metric` String, `_value` Float32, `_baseline` Float32, `_stddev` Float32, `_zscore` Float32) ENGINE = MergeTree PARTITION BY toYYYYMM(_detected_at) ORDER BY (_detected_at, _source_id, _batch_id) SETTINGS index_granularity = 8192

tables.name: quality_metrics
tables.create_table_query: CREATE TABLE etl.quality_metrics (`_metric_id` UUID DEFAULT generateUUIDv4(), `_batch_id` String, `_source_id` String, `_calculated_at` DateTime64(3), `_row_count` UInt64, `_completeness_score` Float32, `_validity_score` Float32, `_consistency_score` Float32, `_quality_score` Float32) ENGINE = MergeTree PARTITION BY toYYYYMM(_calculated_at) ORDER BY (_calculated_at, _source_id, _batch_id) SETTINGS index_granularity = 8192

tables.name: quarantine
tables.create_table_query: CREATE TABLE etl.quarantine (`_quarantine_id` UUID DEFAULT generateUUIDv4(), `_row_id` UUID, `_batch_id` String, `_source_id` String, `_quarantined_at` DateTime64(3), `_quarantine_reason` String, `_validation_errors` Array(String), `_original_row` String, `_reprocessed` Bool DEFAULT false) ENGINE = MergeTree PARTITION BY toYYYYMM(_quarantined_at) ORDER BY (_quarantined_at, _quarantine_id) SETTINGS index_granularity = 8192

tables.name: sales_3months_realistic_csv
tables.create_table_query: CREATE TABLE etl.sales_3months_realistic_csv (`ds` String, `total_sales` Int64, `orders` Int64, `customers` Int64, `_original_dedup_key` String, `_transformed_dedup_key` String, `_batch_id` String, `_schema_version` String, `_extracted_at` DateTime64(3), `_cleaned_at` DateTime64(3), `_loaded_at` DateTime64(3)) ENGINE = ReplacingMergeTree(_loaded_at) PARTITION BY toYYYYMM(_loaded_at) ORDER BY _transformed_dedup_key SETTINGS index_granularity = 8192

tables.name: schema_contract_registry
tables.create_table_query: CREATE TABLE etl.schema_contract_registry (`source_id` String, `schema_version` String, `schema_id` String, `contract_json` String, `updated_at` DateTime64(3)) ENGINE = ReplacingMergeTree(updated_at) PARTITION BY toYYYYMM(updated_at) ORDER BY (source_id, schema_version, schema_id) SETTINGS index_granularity = 8192

kafka.retention: per-topic configs in describe; broker defaults require inspection
